derivation.behavior: Sensitive credentials are scoped and stripped on unsafe cross-origin redirects.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go recomputes credential forwarding per redirect/origin and never blindly propagates Authorization/Cookie.

invariants: Authorization and API-key references are exact-origin scoped.
Cookies require matching origin and path scope.
Cross-origin destinations receive no origin credentials.
Proxy authorization is separated from origin credentials.
Diagnostics expose only structural redaction markers.
